name: reelmind
description: Turn your saved Instagram reels into a visual knowledge workspace. Local-first and open source.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n helper,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w helper" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n helper,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run demo -w helper" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve -w helper
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w helper
